about: Bespoke HD-2D resource cards replacing shared catch-all icons; generated with image_gen, 2026-11-14.

sheets.name: resources_farm
sheets.prompt: Create a production sprite sheet for Fall from Heaven HD-2D fantasy strategy game. EXACTLY NINE different isolated map-object sprites on a regular 3 by 3 grid, in reading order, one object per equal square cell with generous transparent gutters. Transparent background. Full object in each cell, no clipping, no text, no captions, no grid lines. Chunky crisp 16-bit PIXEL ART with visibly deliberate pixel clusters, limited muted earthy olive/brown/slate palette, dark one-pixel outlines, strong upper-left highlights and shadow on lower-right. Three-quarter view looking down about 35 degrees at the front of the objects, consistent scale and lighting. Small-map readability, bold distinctive silhouettes, sculpted details, no photographic texture, no anti-aliased painterly blur, no mist or bloom. Objects stand independently with no terrain tile or cast shadow. Draw exactly these nine objects, left to right across rows: a small pile of charcoal-black gunpowder beside a wooden powder keg; a cluster of reddish copper ore with green patina in grey stone; a small black demonic horse with fiery orange mane and hooves; a bunch of ripe golden bananas with a green banana leaf; two open clam shells with pale cream interiors; three golden ears of maize with folded green husks; a red-brown crab with two large claws; a small pink-brown farm pig with floppy ears; a small sheaf of golden rice stems beside a shallow bowl of white rice
